name: instruct_bench_summarized_short
description: A compact benchmark of math instruction-style problems intended to evaluate models' ability to follow math-oriented instructions and produce concise solutions. It contains shortened/summarized problems derived from larger instruct-style math datasets to enable fast evaluation of reasoning and solution-generation quality. Primarily measures exact correctness of final answers for mathematical questions.
reputation: A niche, task-focused dataset used by researchers experimenting with math reasoning and RAG setups; modest adoption compared with larger math benchmarks.
